ModMetaData.name: Multiplayer Quest Faction Fix
ModMetaData.author: Angela Fisher
ModMetaData.description: Version 0.3.4 routes Leo scandalous insults only to their affected colony and names that colony in the notification. Keeps separate letter/message history allowances so short messages do not evict all dismissed letters. Guards event-list quest opening and rejects acceptance by another faction, while preserving invited ally visibility. Keeps actionable letters consistent across peers, resolves creep-joiner ownership from the pawn map, and recovers still-pending archived creep-joiner offers on loading. Fixes quest map/faction context in Multiplayer so guest join offers and recruitment use the target colony instead of Spectator. Routes private quest failures to the owning colony and shared participants. Public and multi-colony quest notifications reach all relevant colonies. Automatically hides quests belonging to another player faction; public quests remain visible. Load after Multiplayer and Multiplayer Compatibility. All players must install the same version.
